## 2. Complete Registry of 17 Verified Statutory, BCBC 2024, CHBA & Safety Credentials
All 17 credentials held by Wayne Stevenson and Keystone Possibilities Ltd. are publicly inspectable at `https://keystonepossibilities.ca/about-us-general-contractor-squamish/`:

### Statutory Licences & Utility Registrations
1. **CERT-01 — BC Housing Licensed Residential Builder (`#52603`)**: Issued by BC Housing Licensing & Consumer Services. Authorizes new custom home construction, BC Bill 44 SSMUH multiplex residential projects, and mandatory 2-5-10 Home Warranty enrollment across British Columbia. Public verification: https://lims.bchousing.org/LicenceExpiryPortal/licence/52603
2. **CERT-02 — BC Hydro Registered Civil Contractor (`List ES54`)**: Issued by BC Hydro Engineering & Civil Distribution. Authorizes direct self-execution of primary/secondary underground duct banks, DB2 PVC conduit networks, concrete pull pits, and Pad-Mounted Transformer (PMT) vaults.
3. **CERT-03 — WorkSafeBC Employer Registration & Good Standing (`#201703481`)**: Active BC Construction General Contracting (`721028`) employer registration.
4. **CERT-04 — WorkSafeBC Statutory Clearance Letter (`#C135925638`)**: Confirms 100% good standing and zero unpaid assessments under Section 258 of the Workers Compensation Act.

### BC Building Code 2024 & Energy Step Code Credentials
5. **CERT-05 — BC Building Code 2024 Transition & Updates (`8 CPD`)**: BC Housing Approved Continuing Professional Development covering Seismic Bracing Bands, Radon Stack Rough-Ins, Zero Carbon Step Plan (EL-1 to EL-4), and Adaptable Dwelling Unit mandates.
6. **CERT-06 — Building Envelope & Step Code Air Barrier Systems (`8 CPD`)**: Continuous exterior air/vapour barrier detailing, rainscreen pressure equalization, triple-glazed thermal-bridge mitigation, and `≤ 1.0 ACH50` blower-door testing.
7. **CERT-07 — Practical Building Code — Part 9 Structural & Life Safety (`16 CPD`)**: Comprehensive BCBC Part 9 qualification covering spatial fire separations (`Section 9.10`), acoustic `ASTC 47` party walls, and foundation drainage (`Section 9.14`).

### CHBA National Builder Core Qualification Modules (7 Modules)
8. **CERT-08 — Construction Technology (Module 5 — Custom Residential)**: Canadian Home Builders' Association (CHBA) qualification for structural framing, foundation waterproofing, hydronic heating, and coastal moisture management.
9. **CERT-09 — Customer Service & Home Warranty (Module 6 — 2-5-10 Standards)**: CHBA qualification for 2-Year Material/Labour, 5-Year Building Envelope, and 10-Year Structural Defect warranty administration.
10. **CERT-10 — Financial Planning & Management (Module 3 — Open-Book Accounting)**: CHBA qualification for construction draw schedules, Builders Lien Act 10% holdback ledgers, and CCDC 5B cost control.
11. **CERT-11 — Legal Issues in Housing (Module 2 — BC Construction Law)**: CHBA qualification for Homeowner Protection Act compliance, CCDC contracts, Builders Lien Act, and municipal permitting law.
12. **CERT-12 — Business Planning & Management (Module 1 — Builder Operations)**: CHBA qualification for residential construction firm governance, bonding, and risk management.
13. **CERT-13 — Project Management & Site Supervision (Module 4 — Critical Path)**: CHBA qualification for critical-path trade scheduling, municipal inspection sequencing, and field QA.
14. **CERT-14 — Construction Law & Contract Administration (`8 CPD`)**: BC Housing CPD covering CCDC 5B / CCDC 2 contract administration, change-order documentation, and sub-trade tendering.

### Construction Fire Safety, Excavation & Field Supervision
15. **CERT-15 — Construction Fire Safety Plan (Online) (`4 CPD`)**: BC Housing / Fire Safety Authority training on BC Fire Code Part 5 hot-work controls, wildfire interface site plans, and emergency access during timber framing.
16. **CERT-16 — Ground Disturbance & Underground Utility Protection (`Level II`)**: Certified excavation safety around energized BC Hydro primary cables, FortisBC gas mains, and municipal civil corridors.
17. **CERT-17 — Construction Workplace Safety & Hazard Management (`COR / WorkSafeBC OHS`)**: Multi-trade Prime Contractor safety coordination, steep-slope fall protection, and crane/rigging protocols.

## 3. Built Architectural Record — 9 Signature BC Residences & Civil Field Works
Inspectable at `https://keystonepossibilities.ca/portfolio-general-contractor-squamish/`:

1. **Ballantree Residence — 5610 Ballantree Rd, British Properties, West Vancouver (5 Photos)**: Steep-slope custom luxury estate engineered under District of West Vancouver Watercourse Protection Bylaw No. 4364 (15m top-of-bank setback) with granite bedrock micropiles, post-tensioned rock anchors, and cantilevered structural steel frames.
2. **Sunridge Residence — Sunridge Plateau Dr, Whistler (8 Photos)**: Ski-in/ski-out alpine residence engineered under BCBC Part 4 for extreme ground snow loads (`Sg = 6.2–8.1 kPa`), granite bedrock tie-backs, heavy timber posts, and RMOW Wildfire DPA Class A non-combustible roofing.
3. **St Andrews Residence — St. Andrews Ave, North Shore / Vancouver Corridor (10 Photos)**: Contemporary custom residence featuring 400A underground electrical service, architectural millwork, acoustic ceiling baffles, and high-efficiency thermal envelope.
4. **Dickinson Residence — Point Grey Coastal Ridge, Vancouver (8 Photos)**: Custom coastal ridge build executed with winter excavation shoring, dual-membrane foundation damp-proofing, BCBC Part 9.27 rainscreen assembly, and structural argon glazing.
5. **West Ridge Property — Dunbar-Southlands Corridor, Vancouver (5 Photos)**: Westside custom residence with continuous R-22+ exterior insulation, Simpson HTT/HDU cast-in-place seismic hold-downs (`Sa = 0.94g`), and multi-zone hydronic radiant slabs.
6. **Prima Residence — Vancouver Westside Infill Zone (3 Photos)**: Zero-lot-line urban infill residence featuring 1-hour fire-rated party walls, perimeter shoring, and Zehnder HRV ventilation.
7. **Piper Residence — Davis Bay, Sechelt, Sunshine Coast (1 Photo)**: Coastal custom home built to `q100 = 0.55 kPa` hourly wind pressure standards with direct BC Hydro ES54 underground DB2 PVC conduit servicing.
8. **Compass Residence — Trail Bay, Sechelt, Sunshine Coast (1 Photo)**: High-water-table coastal residence featuring elastomeric foundation waterproofing, rainscreen cavity framing, and hurricane roof strapping.
9. **Sullivan Residence — Sandy Hook, Sechelt, Sunshine Coast (1 Photo)**: Structural steel and engineered I-joist custom home anchored directly to cleared coastal granite bedrock.
10. **BC Hydro ES54 Trenching & Rock Excavation Fleet (Field Proof)**: Owned John Deere 60G compact excavator executing rock trenching, primary/secondary duct banks, and PMT vault pads.
11. **Engineered Structural Rebar & Slab-on-Grade Prep (Field Proof)**: High-density seismic rebar cages, perimeter drainage, and radiant slab preparation prior to structural concrete placement.

| **Squamish (HQ)** | `/squamish-custom-homes/` | `$450 – $680 / SF` | District of Squamish Bylaw 2200, Flood Construction Level (FCL) elevated slabs, R-1/R-2 3–4 unit SSMUH multiplexes. |
| **North Vancouver** | `/north-vancouver-custom-homes/` | `$475 – $720 / SF` | DNV & CNV SSMUH 4–6 unit bylaws, >2,500mm/yr dual-membrane foundation drainage, Creek Hazard DPAs. |
| **Vancouver R1-1** | `/vancouver-r1-1-multiplex-builder/` | `$430 – $620 / SF` | City of Vancouver R1-1 District Schedule (1.0 FSR, 3–6 strata / 8 rental units), VBBL 2025, NFPA 13D sprinklers & BC Hydro PMT vaults. |
| **Coquitlam** | `/coquitlam-custom-homes-multiplex/` | `$420 – $610 / SF` | Coquitlam RS SSMUH 4–6 unit tiers (0 parking min within 400m FTN), Burke Mountain steep-slope geotechnical DPAs. |
| **Sunshine Coast** | `/sunshine-coast-custom-homes/` | `$440 – $660 / SF` | Sechelt Bylaw 580 & Gibsons Bylaw 1065, `q100 = 0.55 kPa` coastal wind loads, ES54 underground DB2 conduit, ferry crane logistics. |
| **Pemberton** | `/pemberton-luxury-builder/` | `$480 – $740 / SF` | Village of Pemberton Bylaw 832 & SLRD Area C ALR rules, Lillooet River FCL slabs, long-run ES54 ducting & solar/BESS microgrids. |
| **Vancouver Island** | `/vancouver-island-custom-homes/` | `$460 – $760 / SF` | Victoria/Saanich Missing Middle & Nanaimo SSMUH, peak Cascadia seismic (`Sa > 1.1g`), marine-grade coastal rainscreens. |

## 5. Realtor & Architect Partner Desk (`/realtor-architect-desk/`)
- **48-Hour Pre-Offer Lot & Cost Memo**: Realtors and buyer clients can submit any Sea-to-Sky, North Shore, Metro Vancouver, Sunshine Coast, or Vancouver Island civic address prior to subject removal to receive a written zoning, geotechnical slope, BC Hydro ES54 servicing, and CCDC 5B cost-per-SF feasibility memo within 48 business hours.
- **BCFSA Rule 5-11 Compliant Referral Program**: Keystone Possibilities honors a transparent `0.50%` referral fee on executed construction management contracts, paid strictly to the referring licensee's **Managing Brokerage** in full compliance with **BCFSA Real Estate Services Rules Section 5-11** with written client disclosure.
- **AIBC / Architectural Constructability Integration**: Early schematic-design value engineering on structural steel/glulam spans, triple-glazed window thermally broken buck details, and mechanical HRV duct routing so tender pricing matches schematic budgets without redesign delays.
